population: Pani NHANES 2001-2004 n=3270, adults age>=25, no self-reported diabetes, FPG<126 mg/dL, HbA1c available. Complex survey design and weights. FOS context is different and is not pooled. NHANES overlaps Liu1999-2008. Approximate reconstruction with age-band probabilities proportional to unweighted counts, uniform integer ages below 70, and an assumed declining 70-95 tail; no source individual data or recovered survey weights.

measurement.description: Generated age in years, binary female, BMI kg/m^2, glucose mg/dL and HbA1c percent. Admitted projection unit conversions occur in the shared specification/evidence; feedback applies no transformation. Assay and fasting comparability remain assumptions.

checks.reason: Approximate Pani source-population projection under unweighted sample-count age-band mass, assumed within-band ages/sex/covariates and a shared linear rule. These Monte Carlo statistics do not reproduce the original survey estimator. All eight band means remain diagnostics; only their aggregate location is calibrated, so age-pattern disagreement is possible.
